sources.title: cobalt-seeded-rl-base-ram…ncp5-n3nc-base by Alexander Gurung
sources.snippet: cobalt-seeded-rl-base-ramp25-stoppen-gen4k-ep2-ncp5-n3nc-base is an open-weight model for text generation from Alexander Gurung. It has 4B parameters and a 262,144-token context. At 16-bit it needs about 9.5 GB of GPU memory, which fits on 1x MI300X from $1.85 an hour, at the lowest prices in the SAVRN Index. It draws 1.2k downloads a month.

sources.title: agurung/cobalt-seeded-rl-base-ramp25-stoppen-gen4k-ep2-ncp5-base-q4v2
sources.snippet: The agurung/cobalt-seeded-rl-base-ramp25-stoppen-gen4k-ep2-ncp5-base-q4v2 is a 4 billion parameter Qwen3-based model fine-tuned using OpenRLHF GRPO for code generation tasks. This reinforcement learning checkpoint is optimized for binary code-correctness, achieving a pass@8 score of 3.9063 on the cobalt-train frontier dataset.
